svg.title: White Curve in Relief Over Gray
svg.desc: Interpretive study from a visually inspected primary gallery photograph. Approximate geometry and standardized vivid palette. Photograph perspective, shadows and texture omitted.
svg.metadata: Primary reference: https://matthewmarks.com/exhibitions/ellsworth-kelly-at-ninety-05-2013/lightbox/works/white-curve-in-relief-over-gray-2012-37116; inspected 2026-10-27. This editable vector is a study, not a facsimile.
